title: Fotografía de Producto Premium: Elixir de Bienestar Alpino Suizo
prompt: SWISS ALPINE BOTANICALS is launching a new functional wellness elixir featuring adaptogenic Swiss alpine herbs and natural energy ingredients. As the Creative Director, create a complete high-end promotional shot. The aesthetic should be premium, minimalist, and nature-inspired, featuring the sleek glass bottle with Swiss mountain spring water, organic edelweiss extract, and rhodiola root. Clean white background, soft natural lighting, botanical elements, luxury product photography style, 8K resolution.
